blocks.text: Jandar bahar aur andar ke stimuli (asar daalne wali cheezein, jaise roshni ya chhoona) par radd-e-amal (reaction) dikhate hain. Janwar stimuli ke jawab mein ek jagah se doosri jagah ja sakte hain (locomotion), magar pode ek jagah jame hote hain, is liye woh sirf apni growth ka andaz badal sakte hain.

Tropic movements: podon ki woh growth wali harkatein jo kisi stimulus ki wajah se hoti hain, mil kar tropic movements ya tropisms kehlati hain. Yeh harkatein poore organ ke stimulus (jaise roshni, chhoona, chemical, pani aur gravity) ki taraf ya us se door murne ki shakal mein hoti hain. Podon mein tropic movements ki bari qismein yeh hain:

items: Phototropism: roshni ke stimulus ke jawab mein pode ke kisi hisse ki harkat. Yeh tane ya jar jaise hisse ke ek taraf zyada aur doosri taraf kam barhne (differential growth) se hoti hai. Shoots ke sire aam taur par positive phototropism (roshni ki taraf) dikhate hain, jab ke jarein negative phototropism (roshni se door) dikhati hain.
Geotropism: gravity ke jawab mein pode ke hisson ki harkat. Jarein positive geotropism (neeche ki taraf) aur shoots negative geotropism (oopar ki taraf) dikhate hain.

Thigmotropism: chhoone (touch) ke jawab mein harkat, misal ke taur par charhne wali belein (climbing vines). Jab bel kisi thos cheez ko chhooti hai to chhoone wali jagah ki doosri taraf growth barh jati hai aur tendril sahare ke gird lipat jata hai.
Chemotropism: kuch chemicals ke jawab mein harkat ko chemotropism kehte hain. Fungi ke hyphae (dhaage) chemotropic hote hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar khaane. Phototropism: pauda suraj (light) ki taraf mura hai aur jar mitti mein neeche. Geotropism: beej se shoot upar aur jar neeche barhti hai, neela teer gravity dikhata hai. Thigmotropism: bel ka tendril sahare (support) ki lakri ke gird lipta hai. Chemotropism: fungus ki hypha chemical wale daire ki taraf barhti hai.
blocks.caption: Chaar tropisms: phototropism, geotropism, thigmotropism aur chemotropism (hamara apna khaaka; kitab is jagah koi figure nahin chhapti).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har khaane mein dekhein poda kis cheez ki taraf ya us se door barhta hai: shoot roshni ki taraf (positive phototropism), jar gravity ki taraf neeche (positive geotropism), tendril chhoone par sahare ke gird (thigmotropism), aur fungus ki hypha kisi chemical ki taraf (chemotropism).

blocks.prompt: Ek beej andhere mein ulta bo diya jata hai. Batayein ke us ki jar aur shoot kis taraf barhenge, aur har ek ke liye tropism ka naam aur us ka nishan (positive ya negative) batayein.
blocks.explanation: Jar mur kar neeche ki taraf barhegi: positive geotropism. Shoot mur kar oopar ki taraf barhega: negative geotropism. Andhere mein roshni nahin, is liye yahan phototropism ka koi kirdar nahin.

items: Pode jagah nahin badal sakte, is liye stimuli ka jawab growth wali harkaton (tropisms) se dete hain: organ stimulus ki taraf (positive) ya us se door (negative) murta hai.

Phototropism (roshni: shoots positive, jarein negative), geotropism (gravity: jarein positive, shoots negative), thigmotropism (chhoona: tendril lipatta hai) aur chemotropism (chemicals: fungi ke hyphae).
